method: CPU1 thread CPU time, balanced baseline/candidate process order; all builds/tests stopped; matching headers; same consumer objects reused where public headers match. Initial stage comparisons use the original dispatcher; final comparisons add resonant coverage and rebuild matching dispatcher consumers
memory_notes: approx_allocated_bytes is implementation-specific shared table accounting; heap_bytes is mallinfo2(uordblks+hblkhd) delta after finish; RSS includes validation and report allocations
comparison_notes: C4 flat sparse hashing and the subsequent single-multiply hash experiment were withdrawn after performance/generalization regressions. final-paired is the unreleased initial C5 implementation. corrected-final-paired compares the selected final implementation to baseline. Incomplete hash-paired samples are excluded.
